scripts.build:box-template: node scripts/build-waterbox.mjs cli && bun run scripts/build-box-system-template.ts
scripts.start:api-local: bun run --cwd packages/sandbox-cli build && bun run apps/api-local/src/main.ts
scripts.experiment:control-plane-mcp: bun run --cwd packages/sandbox-cli build && bun run scripts/control-plane-mcp-experiment.ts
scripts.chat:control-plane-mcp: bun run --cwd packages/sandbox-cli build && bun run scripts/control-plane-mcp-experiment.ts --interactive
scripts.smoke:mcp-direct: bun run build:mcp && bun run scripts/direct-mcp-smoke.ts
scripts.smoke:mcp-vercel: bun run build:mcp && bun run scripts/vercel-mcp-smoke.ts
scripts.check:premerge: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:node-sqlite && git diff --check "$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)"..HEAD && git diff --check && git diff --cached --check
scripts.check:release: bun run check:premerge && bun run build:mcp && npm pack --dry-run ./packages/mcp
